prompt:
Create a corrected production pixel-art multiplayer sprite sheet for Scrapper based on the reference: Echo, violet armored salvager, cyan visor, orange flame thrower. Keep exact character armor, helmet, palette and gun. Four columns and eight rows EXACTLY: 32 isolated complete full-body sprites. Each cell is wide with at least 16 pixel magenta margin on all sides; no text, no grid lines, no shadows. Solid exact #ff00ff chroma key background. Pixel art with dark outlines, shaded metal, limited palette matching the reference.
The FIRST FOUR ROWS are one 16-angle clockwise turntable, viewed at standing human eye level (not top down). Row 1: facing viewer 0°, front-right 22.5°, front-right45°, front-right67.5°. Row2: right profile90°, rear-right112.5°, rear-right135°, rear-right157.5°. Row3: back180°, rear-left202.5°, rear-left225°, rear-left247.5°. Row4: left profile270°, front-left292.5°, front-left315°, front-left337.5°. Feet are in left-step walking pose.
Rows5–8 repeat those SAME sixteen angles, with opposite right-step walking pose. Guns point along the character's facing direction in both hands, do not always point sideways or at viewer. Back views show backpack, no visor. Side profiles show one side of helmet. FOUR columns only, full consistent body scale, feet on aligned baselines. Exactly 32 full-body sprites, no partial, duplicate or extra columns.

If you need to use a generated image at another path, copy it and leave the original in place unless the user explicitly asks you to delete it.
The generated image is already displayed to the user. There is no need to render it in the final response as a Markdown image or file link.
